fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-11 11:30 to 2026-11-12 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (`group-state` pause = ok).

1. Decisions for you: four, unchanged, nothing new this cycle (each is a proposed decision in the group log).
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 13 days): srs#1016 landed on 9 Nov, so it may be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 13 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 8 days): recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 15 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. The four merged PRs cite rulings already ratified (bf4a5af5, f3f7308e, 90fe6c0d, charter 00567bf1); no `proposed` record from the builder awaits assent, so no group session was held.

3. Done: 4 PRs merged (builder / reviewer / mandate, all approve; findings none):
- srs-rust#1634 record create and update report every cross-field violation (#1622): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-90, RFC-019 [R2], 00567bf1 (merged 11 Nov 11:32, two minutes after the last close, counted here)
- srs-rust#1645 `record duplicate`, a core service for CLI, WASM and MCP (#1505): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / 90fe6c0d
- srs-rust#1644 relation list reads carry each relation's createdBy (#1411): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / f3f7308e
- srs-rust#1643 find-by-target-type gets diagnosticsStructured (#1339 slice 10): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / bf4a5af5
Issues to check for closure: srs-rust#1622, #1505, #1411.

4. Stuck or lost: no red gates reported by runs. Open group PRs (4):
- srs-rust#1646 render composition --section (#1510): reviewer rejected, gate red (`site/public/cli` out of date; needs regeneration). Builder's to fix.
- srs-web#782 type subtypes from the core (#336): rejected, merge conflict on `scripts/ensure-bindings.mjs` (main pins build.643, the head build.639). Needs a rebase.
- srs#1021 docs, three relation-layer statements (#1018): approved, gates green, labelled `gate:auto-merge`, waiting on the merge step.
- srs-rust#1640 publish srs-bindings to npm from promoted releases (#819): approved, gates green, waiting on the merge step.
Stops (needs-input) as last cycle: srs-rust#1495, #1164, srs-web#691 (waits on bc6bc746), srs-web#632. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 4 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 4 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: the four proposed decisions in section 1 are the only pending ones. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: open `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` issues by count: srs 7, srs-rust 11, srs-web 1, srs-vscode 0, semanticops.com 0 (19 in all; some are blocked or in PRs, so buildable is lower; I did not triage each). Local priorities: none set. Queue fed for about 2 cycles at 10 a day, less where items are blocked. Waits on the owner: the four decisions above. Fed by the analyst: 2026-11-11 (filed 10 rulings, unparked 4).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the open ones in the last report stand (2d521997, 3956749c, b032e064, 6f3839be, c636bb69, 920ab2a5, 7131fe89).

7. What we learned: two PRs are approved and green yet not merged, while two others are rejected on cheap defects (a stale generated doc, a stale pin): the merge step is now the slower part, not review. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions across both logs, then srs-web#560): not counted exactly, not flagged. Measurement I1: 0 of 0 PRs merged in the window grounded (the window opens at the 11:30 `cycleStart` read at the close, so it is empty); result ad351290-01b1-4364-9b18-f5ff3cb2f259 (records/tier-2/measurement-result-ad351290.json). Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
